rebind.rule: EVERY boundary's coordinate was re-resolved at the candidate source head by (file, qualified operation) with the closure tool's own span resolver, and every span_sha256 is that resolver's hash.  The superseded coordinate is kept as inventory_line.  No recorded line is used for identity.  A boundary is SAFETY_DISCHARGED only where the b78 review recorded ACCEPT for it (verdict/review_receipt below); every other boundary carries a non-discharging disposition, so this receipt cannot discharge a site the review did not accept.
rebind.reviewed_cohort: 65 obligations = the 56 the b77 closure adjudicated under openssh-v1i plus the 9 under openssh-v1l
rebind.prior_evidence_note: contract/established_by/implementation_guarantees/criteria/residual are the earlier receipt's text, preserved as prior_evidence; where it cites a superseded line or a call path that no longer exists, the b78 verdict fields are the operative evidence.

method: The unsafe fn is read at the exact line; every registration/call site is located with grep; the contract is stated for the caller; a control is run against the frozen libcrypto/libssl (unknown-obligations-v1l-negctl.c), forking each case so a signal is an observed result.
